display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (REM): (Apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with no oxygen desaturation used and with or without arousal) / hour of sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in REM sleep (>= 0% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hrembp + hrop + carbp + carop + oarbp +oarop + marbp + marop) / minremp
